title: Choose Stash's new world
question: The roll assigned the Rotary Card File. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Rotary Card File
options.thesis: Finding is a turn of the knob: type, and the drum spins to the card.
options.viewport: Headline left; a large flat-drawn rotary drum right whose knob is a working search field. Type and it clicks to the matching card.
options.risk: Tips into a glossy skeuomorphic toy if the drum is rendered instead of drawn flat and precise.

raised.raise: Every zone carries its literal name on an index tab; wayfinding is reading.
Every keystroke moves the object: the query physically turns the drum.
Motion is a counted sequence: the drum clicks card by card, never a smooth blur.
Geometry is data: a card's angle on the drum is its place in the alphabet.
State is a mark, not a hue: a notch for shared, a punched corner for archived.

options.label: Back-of-Book Index
options.thesis: The landing is the index of a stash: terms, locators, see-also.
options.viewport: A full two-column index page; typing in the search filters entries live and the locators light up.
options.risk: Familiar: sits close to the hairline editorial look many runs land on.

options.label: Cracktro Scroller
options.thesis: Saved things ride baselines over a black void; the match you want comes forward.
options.viewport: One still ivory line, your query, with results drifting behind at depth; the best match pulls to the front.
options.case: Holds identification for a dev-leaning circle; loses on clarity to a visitor who just wants to know what Stash is.
options.risk: Reads novelty; bitmap type fights Thai titles.

options.label: Industrial Quote Grammar
options.thesis: Ordinary words in straight quotes, zip-tie tags, hazard stripes.
options.case: Loses both axes: fashion swagger, not a trusted archive.
options.risk: Shouts at a product built on quiet.
options.kept: Literal labeling: every zone names itself.

options.label: Alphabet Storm
options.thesis: Letters condense into words and break into weather.
options.case: Loses both axes: spectacle hides the plain job.

options.label: Desert Neon Sign Program
options.thesis: A tall porcelain sign with a numbered chase-lamp arrow.
options.viewport: A sign elevation pointing at the CTA.
options.case: Loses both axes: roadside promise, not private archive.
options.kept: Motion as a counted, numbered sequence.

options.label: Labanotation Score
options.thesis: A vertical staff where shape and length are exact data.
options.viewport: Saves as blocks rising up a time staff.
options.case: Loses both axes: unreadable notation for a plain tool.

options.label: Cutting Bench Select Rail
options.thesis: A perforated rail of frames on grain orange.
options.viewport: Saves strung along a film rail.
options.case: Loses both axes: an editor's workflow, not a stash.
options.risk: Orange third of screen overwhelms content.
options.kept: State is a mark, not a hue.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.viewport: Headline, CTA, app screenshot, three feature rows.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from Pocket and Raindrop by design.
